motds.body: Equip a Sprite before each match for a unique Sprite Power, like threat tracking or shield regeneration. Level them up through eliminations, opening chests, and reviving teammates for stronger effects, and secure new Sprites at Extraction Sites to build your Collection!
motds.title: Secure the Win With Sprites!

motds.body: Instantly unlock the The Guardian Outfit and get the bonus Gold Huntress Dylan Style with accessories when you buy the Battle Pass or have an active Crew subscription. Available now through June 13 at 11:59 PM ET!
motds.tabTitle: Battle Pass Bonus Outfit Style & Instant Unlock
motds.title: Battle Pass Bonus Outfit Style & Instant Unlock

motds.body: Get the drop on opponents with the Seven Slider, which unlocks high-speed slides with slow-motion and increased accuracy when aiming while sliding. Master new weapons like the Chaos Exploder Rifle with rounds that detonate on contact, the triple-barreled Extending Focus Shotgun for up close eliminations, and more!
motds.title: Gear Up Like a Runner!

motds.body: The unstoppable hitman has joined the fight. Take down enemies with John Wick’s signature precision and style, including finishing moves and a tactical reload throw. Battle Pass owners can unlock the John Wick Outfit and rescue his dog in Battle Royale to earn a Sidekick!
motds.title: Baba Yaga Hits the Scene

motds.body: The Zero Point is an orb of pure energy, thought to be the origin of all reality. Freed from the Imagined Order by Seven heroes, it was shattered. Now, the fractured Zero Point has been reforged, but its instability has resulted in powerful Sprites appearing on the Island! Meanwhile, a sinister force observes from the shadows, manipulating events to his own ends…
motds.title: An Ancient Source of Power

messages.body: Commanders, we've moved the Save the World message of the day to appear when you first log into Fortnite!
messages.title: Message of the day update
